name: 1 Samuel
lede: The ninth book of the Bible, in full: Hannah's son Samuel, the ark among the Philistines, Saul the first king, and David the shepherd, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Hannah
books.blurb: Hannah in bitterness of soul at Shiloh, her vow, and Eli marking her mouth; Samuel born and lent to Jehovah — for this child I prayed; Hannah's song; the sons of Eli and the flesh-hook; the child Samuel in his linen ephod; and the man of God: them that honor me I will honor.

books.name: Speak, Jehovah
books.blurb: The lamp of God not yet gone out: Samuel, Samuel — speak; for thy servant heareth. The ark fetched from Shiloh and taken at Eben-ezer; Eli fallen by the gate; Ichabod, the glory is departed; Dagon fallen before the ark, and the ark carried about Ashdod, Gath and Ekron.

books.name: Give Us a King
books.blurb: The ark sent home on a new cart with golden tumors and mice, two milch kine lowing on the straight way to Beth-shemesh; Mizpah, the great thunder, and the stone Eben-ezer: hitherto hath Jehovah helped us. Then the elders at Ramah: make us a king to judge us like all the nations.

books.name: Saul Anointed
books.blurb: Kish's asses lost, and Saul, higher than any of the people, sent to seek them; the seer at the high place and the thigh reserved for him; the vial of oil; the band of prophets — is Saul also among the prophets?; the lot at Mizpah, Saul hid among the baggage, and long live the king.
